groups.label: Thanksgiving Break
items: Thanksgiving Break runs November 25–27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

groups.label: Winter Break
items: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is an optional teacher workday, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

groups.label: Spring Break
items: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: The 2026–27 school year starts one day earlier, on August 24 instead of August 25.
Spring Break moves earlier, from March 30–April 3 in 2025–26 to March 22–26 in 2026–27.

calendarFaqs.q: When does GCS start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students begin classes on Monday, August 24, 2026, on the GCS 2026–27 Traditional Academic Calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for GCS?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day on the GCS 2026–27 Traditional Academic Calendar is Thursday, June 10, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: GCS Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCS Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is an optional teacher workday, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Which GCS teacher workdays are no-school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: The Traditional Academic Calendar lists optional teacher workdays on September 21, October 30, and January 4, plus mandatory teacher workdays on November 3, January 25, February 15, and April 5. Students do not attend on these seven dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every GCS school follow the Traditional Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page covers the GCS Traditional Calendar. Extended-year schools and some early/middle college programs use separate academic calendars, so confirm the calendar assigned to your student's school or program.
